The package() function installs the built binaries, man page, documentation, and license to standard system directories, all with appropriate permissions.

No dangerous commands (e.g., `eval`, `curl|bash`, `base64` decoding, or remote code execution) are present. All operations are confined to the build directory and package directory, and no external scripts are downloaded or executed during build or install. The optdepends list references related tools (miniprot, k8) which are legitimate dependencies for extended functionality, as documented in the upstream project.
</details>
